name: Shabaloth
ability: Each night*, choose 2 players: they die. A dead player you chose last night might be regurgitated.
interaction: Points at two players, one at a time; both die. Before waking it, the Storyteller may return one player it chose last night to life (ALIVE reminder); that player is announced alive at dawn with no reason given.
drunk_or_poisoned: Chosen players do not die and no one can be regurgitated.

rulings.text: Two separate attacks: a protected target (e.g. Monk/Innkeeper) survives while the other dies.

Regurgitation is the Storyteller's choice of one dead player the Shabaloth chose last night (whether it killed them or they were already dead), just before the Shabaloth wakes; a regurgitated player regains their ability, including used once-per-game and first-night abilities (a first-night ability is used immediately).
The Shabaloth cannot regurgitate itself; dead, it has no ability.
Regurgitate rarely (about once or twice a game), usually a good player.

test_scenarios.name: double kill
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Shabaloth, Bob Chef, Carol Empath, Dave Monk, Eve Poisoner, Fay Mayor, Gus Slayer
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Shabaloth chooses Bob and Carol.
test_scenarios.expected: Bob and Carol die; both announced dead at dawn.

test_scenarios.name: one target protected
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Shabaloth, Dave Monk, Bob Chef, Carol Empath
test_scenarios.actions: Night 2: Monk protects Bob; Shabaloth chooses Bob and Carol.

test_scenarios.name: regurgitation
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Shabaloth; Carol Empath killed by her night 2
test_scenarios.actions: Night 3: Storyteller regurgitates Carol before the Shabaloth wakes.
test_scenarios.expected: Carol is alive with ALIVE reminder and wakes as Empath that night; dawn announces Carol is alive again, without a reason.

test_scenarios.name: regurgitation restores once-per-game
test_scenarios.setup: Gus Slayer used his shot on day 1, then was killed by the Shabaloth night 2
test_scenarios.expected: Gus may use the Slayer ability again.

test_scenarios.name: poisoned shabaloth
test_scenarios.setup: Alice Shabaloth poisoned by Eve Poisoner
